user.title: Connect to Virtual Carillon
user.description: Enter the URL of the Virtual Carillon API, the optional bearer token, and the LitCal settings.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Virtual Carillon API.

abort.already_configured: This Virtual Carillon API is already configured.

init.title: Virtual Carillon schedules
init.description: Turn on Westminster once, then add manual or automatic schedules. Manual schedules play a selected asset or hymn; automatic schedules let LitCal choose the hymn. Each schedule can contain multiple times, selected days, a daily time window, and Home Assistant media players.

menu_options.add_routine: Add a manual or automatic schedule...

westminster.title: Westminster
westminster.description: Choose the cadence, days, daily time window, and Home Assistant speakers. Hour strikes automatically use the actual hour count.

add_routine.title: Add a manual or automatic schedule
add_routine.description: Choose Manual to play a specific asset or hymn, or Automatic to let LitCal choose a hymn. Enter one or more exact times such as 12:00, 18:00, select days, and optionally limit the daily time window.

edit_routine_details.title: Edit scheduled playback
edit_routine_details.description: Change the mode, selected asset or hymn, automatic hour, times, days, time window, or speakers.

error.asset_required: Choose an asset when Play is set to Asset.
error.invalid_times: Enter one or more times in HH:MM format, separated by commas.
error.media_players_required: Select at least one Home Assistant media player.

abort.cannot_connect: The schedule could not be saved to Virtual Carillon.

play.name: Play asset
play.description: Render and play an asset through the selected Home Assistant media players.

asset.name: Asset
asset.description: The stable Virtual Carillon asset ID to play.

stop.name: Stop playback
stop.description: Stop playback on the selected Home Assistant media players.

select_hymn.name: Select and play a hymn
select_hymn.description: Select a hymn using LitCal and optional filters, then play it through the selected media players.

fixed_asset_id.name: Fixed asset ID
fixed_asset_id.description: Exact hymn asset ID for fixed selection.

category_ids.name: Category IDs
category_ids.description: Category IDs to use as a selection filter.

feast_ids.name: Feast IDs
feast_ids.description: Feast IDs to use as a LitCal condition and selection filter.

offices.name: Office IDs
offices.description: Office IDs to use as a selection filter.

seasons.name: Season IDs
seasons.description: Season IDs to use as a LitCal condition and selection filter.

canonical_hours.name: Canonical hours
canonical_hours.description: Canonical hour IDs to use as a selection filter.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Asset tags to use as a selection filter.

recent_exclusion.name: Recent exclusion
recent_exclusion.description: Number of recently selected assets to avoid.

fallback_asset.name: Fallback asset
fallback_asset.description: Asset to play if no hymn matches.
